objective: Calibrate the 18-shift employment path against actual accepted-shift history and reduce single-employer concentration risk without adding cost.

baseline.source: Existing shift-assignment notices in the connected mailbox.
baseline.deduplication: Unique scheduled work date across original, resend, and site-change notices.
baseline.privacy: No person, employer, customer, coworker, address, email, phone, message identifier, or secret is stored.

interpretation.direct_18_shift_path: Feasible but not a central-case assumption: it occurred once in twelve observed pay periods.
interpretation.contract_normal_20_day_month: Preserved as a contractual norm, not treated as proof that 18 future assignments will be accepted.
interpretation.biggest_uncertainty: Past counts combine user availability and employer assignment supply; their separate causal contributions are not observable from email.

hybrid_path.rationale: Two-source 18-workday mix reaches the target with 16 primary shifts plus at most two non-overlapping event shifts, if current app jobs safely provide at least JPY 20,800 combined.

app_public_readback.immediate_pay_timing: Within two business days where eligible.

hybrid_path.reason_not_counted: No current user-specific app listing or accepted event assignment has been read back.

safe_event_gate: Use only an already installed and authenticated app; do not re-register or transmit identity data for this check.
Use only dates not requested or accepted by the primary employer.
Apply to at most two physically safe jobs whose combined displayed gross is at least JPY 20,800.
Read the full hours, commute, return route, gross, payment timing, cancellation rule, and required items before the user personally applies.
If any gate fails, do not apply; report the highest displayed gross or that no eligible job exists.

success_condition: A binding next-30-day gross run rate or verified trailing-30-day gross reaches at least JPY 200,000.
withdrawal_condition: Do not count or apply to event jobs if current inventory, gross, non-overlap, physical safety, commute, payment, or cancellation terms are unverified.
effect_window: Through the 2026-09-25 payroll read-back for the target period; remeasure accepted assignments whenever new notices arrive.
